completeness_note: 10 distinct umbrella MODELS confirmed from 12 source images (10 banner screenshots + 2 real-photo JPG albums). EX019 is the only existing SKU (golf 30in 2-layer two-tone) and is fully covered by its own real-photo JPGs. 9 models need NEW SKUs. DEDUP applied: the two 16-rib cane banners (Screenshot 155559 @85฿ and 155632 @80฿) were merged into ONE model — same 16-rib cane body, different color batch/price (flagged for supplier to confirm 1 vs 2 SKUs). The two LINE_ALBUM JPGs both belong to EX019 and were not double-counted. No non-product/junk images found. All source banners carry the New Fly 'ร่มนิวฟลาย' watermark and wholesale prices; for new SKUs, clean studio re-shoots are recommended (banners are watermarked color-lineup sheets, not catalogue-ready). One open question for supplier: whether the 30in manual single-layer (130฿) is EX019's solid-color variant or a separate SKU.
